CoworkDelta.description:
`event: delta`: more reply text. `event: reset` (empty object) means discard the text
so far: the model is retrying after invalid output.
CoworkDelta.title: CoworkDelta

CoworkFailed.description: `event: error`; the stored assistant message is marked failed.
CoworkFailed.title: CoworkFailed

applied_version.description: The version this proposal became, if any.
applied_version.title: Applied Version

CoworkStarted.description: First SSE event of a chat reply (`event: started`).
CoworkStarted.title: CoworkStarted

rejected_idea_reasons.description: Reasons from earlier rejections; Mode B steers away from these.
rejected_idea_reasons.title: Rejected Idea Reasons

IdeaUpdated.description: A new version (applied patch, re-score) or a status change (rejected, selected).
IdeaUpdated.title: IdeaUpdated

score_stale.description: The idea was edited after it was last scored; re-score to update it.
score_stale.title: Score Stale

JobAccepted.description: Work queued in the worker; progress and the result arrive on the run's stream.
JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted

is_generic.description: True for undifferentiated ideas such as "AI chatbot for X".
is_generic.title: Is Generic

iteration.description: Scout pass that produced this opportunity.
iteration.title: Iteration

signal_strength.description: 10 = several independent, specific signals; 1 = generic idea.
signal_strength.title: Signal Strength

RubricScore.description: 1-10 where 10 is always the favourable end (lowest risk / best outlook).
RubricScore.title: RubricScore

SourcedFigure.description: A number that is either backed by a URL or explicitly labelled as an estimate.

assumption.description: Required when there is no source_url: how the estimate was derived.
assumption.title: Assumption

get.description: The saved founder profile, or defaults (`updated_at: null`) if none was saved.

put.description: Replaces the founder profile. Mode B runs snapshot it when they are created.

post.description: Queues a run; the worker executes it. Progress arrives on `/runs/{id}/stream`.

Merges 2-4 active ideas into a hybrid in the worker: Scout synthesis, then Analyst and
Skeptic. Progress and the new idea (`idea.created`) arrive on the run's stream.

409.description: Conflicts with the run's current state

get.description: The idea at its latest version plus every version (oldest first), for diffs.
The chat on this idea, oldest first. A reply still being generated is `pending`.

post.description:
Chat with one agent about this idea; the reply streams back. The agent may propose a
change (`proposed_patch` on the completed message), which `POST …/versions` applies.
The reply is stored even if this connection drops.

200.description: SSE. `started` (CoworkStarted), then `delta` (CoworkDelta) events with reply text, `reset` when a retry discards the text so far, and finally `completed` (CoworkMessageView) or `error` (CoworkFailed).

409.description: Conflicts with the run's current state

post.description:
Rejects the idea. The reason is kept in the founder profile, so the next Mode B runs
steer away from it.

409.description: Conflicts with the run's current state

post.description:
The Skeptic re-scores the latest version in the worker; `agent.*` and `idea.updated`
arrive on the run's stream.

409.description: Conflicts with the run's current state

post.description:
Applies an agent's proposed patch as the idea's next version (201). The same proposal
applied again returns that version (200). The score is then stale until re-scored.

409.description: Conflicts with the run's current state

post.description:
Selects the idea to develop and resumes the graph into Phase 2. Idempotent: repeating
the same selection returns 202 without resuming again; another idea is a 409.

409.description: Conflicts with the run's current state

get.description:
Server-sent events for one run, in order, each with `id:` = the event id.

Replays every event after `Last-Event-ID` (header, as sent by EventSource on
reconnect, or `?last_event_id=`), then streams live. Each `data:` is one JSON `Event`
envelope. Comment pings keep idle connections open. The stream closes once the run is
`completed`, `failed` or `budget_exhausted` and every event has been sent.

parameters.description: Initial cursor; the header wins when both are set.
parameters.name: last_event_id

schema.description: Initial cursor; the header wins when both are set.
schema.title: Last Event Id

id.description: The event id; send back as Last-Event-ID.
